questions.q:
*(Refer to the passage provided in Question 21)*

From the context in which it is placed, the phrase “sui generis” in paragraph 3 suggests which one of the following?
questions.explain: In paragraph 3, the author contrasts reproducing 'patterns... of a traditional nature' with exploring 'sui generis languages and forms'. 'Sui generis' means unique, of its own kind, or particular to itself. Option (a) 'Particular' is the closest match to expressing that these forms are highly specific and unique to the electronic medium.
